description: Top-level index for SolidWorks CAD authoring operations. SolidWorks is a feature-tree-based parametric CAD system with discrete environments (Part, Assembly, Drawing) and explicit Sheet Metal + Weldment modes. This index covers the full CAD authoring surface: sketch_operations (2D constraint solver + dimensions + relations), part_operations (features + bodies + patterns + boolean), surface_operations (lofted/swept/boundary/fill + knit/trim/extend), assembly_operations (16+ mate types + components + configurations), drawing_operations (views + dimensions + GD&T + BOM), sheet_metal_operations (flange/bend/unfold + K-factor), weldment_operations (structural members + cut list + welds), and evaluation_operations (measure/mass/interference/cost/sustainability). Consumed by SolidWorksCADFunctionIndexEngine for parameter discovery and AI orchestration of SolidWorks CAD authoring via SolidWorks API COM (ISldWorks/IModelDoc2/IPartDoc/IAssemblyDoc/IDrawingDoc), VBA macro execution, and VSTA add-ins. Mirrors Inventor (8 modules, 983 params) and Mastercam (8 modules, 815 params) parity.

modules.description: 2D sketching layer: 22 operations covering primitive geometry (line / centerline / circle / arc / spline / style_spline / polygon / rectangle / slot / ellipse / partial_ellipse / conic / point / text), constraints (smart_dimension across 10 modes + add_relation across 16 geometric relation types), and sketch modify ops (sketch_fillet / sketch_chamfer / trim_entities / extend_entities / offset_entities / mirror_entities). Bindings target SolidWorks API ISketchManager + IFeatureManager.InsertSketch. Foundation layer for part_operations (every extrude/revolve/sweep/loft starts from a sketch) and the lineage anchor for design-table-driven dimensional relationships.

Solid feature layer: 30 operations covering the four sweep families with boss + cut variants (extrude / revolve / sweep / loft — 8 ops with 8 termination modes on extrude), boundary surface→solid, the hole wizard (5 hole types × 5 termination modes folded into one op), 5 apply features (rib / dome / indent / flex / thicken), 4 modify features (fillet / chamfer / shell / draft including variable-radius and neutral-plane modes), 6 patterns (linear / circular / curve-driven / sketch-driven / table-driven / fill), mirror_feature, and 4 body operations (move-copy / scale / combine / split). Bindings target SolidWorks API IFeatureManager (FeatureExtrusion3 / FeatureRevolve2 / FeatureSweep / FeatureLoft / etc.) and IModelDoc2 body operations. Foundation for assembly_operations (components are part instances), drawing_operations (views derive from feature-tree topology), sheet_metal_operations (sheet metal subsets the part-modeling environment), and weldment_operations (weldment is multi-body part topology).

Surface modeling layer: 20 operations covering 7 sweep families (extrude / revolve / sweep / loft / boundary / ruled / radiated), 3 patch creators (fill / planar / extracted-from-body), 6 modify ops (offset / trim / untrim / extend / knit / replace_face), 3 face-level ops (delete_face / move_face / delete_hole-via-trim), and 2 surface→solid converters (thicken / knit-to-solid). Bindings target SolidWorks API IFeatureManager surface methods (FeatureExtruRefSurface3 / FeatureRevolveSurface2 / FeatureSurfaceLoft / FeatureBoundarySurface / InsertFilledSurfaceFeature2 / InsertOffsetSurface2 / InsertRuledSurface2 / RadiatedSurfaceFeature / InsertPlanarSurface / InsertSurfaceFromBody / InsertSurfaceTrim2 / FeatureUntrimSurface / InsertExtendSurfaceFeature / InsertSewingFeature / InsertReplaceFace2 / InsertDeleteFace / InsertMoveFace2 / InsertThickenFeature). Foundation for hybrid solid-surface workflows on imported geometry, mold parting surfaces, and class-A automotive/consumer surfacing.

(pending) Assembly layer: 16+ mate types (standard concentric/coincident/distance/angle/parallel/perpendicular/tangent/lock/limit + advanced symmetric/width/path/linear_coupler + mechanical cam/gear/screw/hinge/slot/universal_joint), components (insert/replace/configurations), patterns, mirror_components, exploded view, smart_fasteners, in_context_modeling.

(pending) Drawing layer: sheet/title_block, 9 view types (model/projected/auxiliary/section/detail/broken/break_out/crop/relative), 6 dimension types, GD&T (ASME Y14.5 14 characteristics), surface_finish, weld_symbols, BOM, revision_table, design_tables.

(pending) Sheet metal layer: base_flange / edge_flange / miter_flange / hem / jog / sketched_bend / lofted_bend / swept_flange / cross_break / gusset / vent / corner_relief / forming_tool, K-factor + bend tables + gauge tables, unfold/fold/flatten.
(pending) Weldment layer: structural_member (with profile library), trim_extend, gusset, end_cap, weld_bead, cut_list, weld_symbols, custom_profile, multi_body management.

(pending) Evaluation layer: measure, mass_properties, section_properties, interference_detection, collision_detection, clearance_verification, performance_evaluation, draft_analysis, undercut_analysis, deviation_analysis, thickness_analysis, symmetry_check, design_checker, costing, sustainability.
